Implemented the feature contract: wrapped the Changelist `list_editable` POST processing in `ModelAdmin.changelist_view` (django/contrib/admin/options.py) in a database transaction.

Change made (lines ~2012-2022): the loop that saves each changed form (`save_form`, `save_model`, `save_related`, `log_change`) is now enclosed in `with transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model)):`, so a failure mid-way rolls back all edits instead of leaving the database in an inconsistent state. `transaction` and `router` were already imported in the module.

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection (`admin_changelist`) passed — 74 tests ran, 0 failures.
